ar.title: اللحم بالدمعة

steps.n1: يقطع اللحم قطعا متوسطة ثم يحمر في الزيت أو السمن، ثم يضاف إليه الثوم المفري ويقلب حتى يصفر لونه، ثم يتبل بالملح والفلفل.
steps.n2: تضرب الطماطم في الخلاط ثم تضاف إلى اللحم حتى ينضج قوامها.
steps.n3: يضاف الخل ويقلب جيدا، ثم تضاف حوالي 2 كوب ماء، ويترك على درجة حرارة هادئة حتى النضج.

en.title: Meat with Tear Sauce
en.intro: This is a traditional Egyptian dish prepared with fresh ingredients and aromatic spices.

steps.n1: Cut the meat into medium pieces and brown it in oil or ghee, then add the crushed garlic and stir until golden, then season with salt and pepper.
steps.n2: Blend the tomatoes and add them to the meat until the sauce thickens and cooks down.
steps.n3: Add the vinegar and stir well, then add about 2 cups of water, and simmer over low heat until fully cooked.

legacySteps: Cut the meat into medium pieces and brown it in oil or ghee, then add the crushed garlic and stir until golden, then season with salt and pepper.
Blend the tomatoes and add them to the meat until the sauce thickens and cooks down.
Add the vinegar and stir well, then add about 2 cups of water, and simmer over low heat until fully cooked.
